text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analysts Mary Bourque and Sharon Bazbaz on Monday raised their rating for Chile's Manufacturas de Cobre SA, or Madeco, to buy from market performer.
-- The upgrade was based on the stock's "very attractive valuation," they wrote in a report.
-- "We believe that our $31 per ADR (American Depositary Receipt) price target should be easily achieved by year-end."

-- They kept their 1998 earnings-per-share estimate of $1.73 per ADR and reduced their 1997 estimate to $1.23 per ADR from $1.26 "to reflect the carry-through effect of the weaker-than-expected 4Q/96 results in packaging and telecommunications in the first half of 1997."
-- The company's ADRs were unchanged at 25-3/4 on Monday.
